description.value: C Market Coffee is a design-forward café chain with four Tri-Cities and Vancouver locations that roasts high-quality Arabica micro-lot beans in-house and pairs them with freshly made food. The Coquitlam outpost is part of a brand that also runs coffee classes, pop-up markets, and room rentals, giving it a community hub character beyond a typical café stop. Note that the business is cashless, so card or app payment is required.
